---
title: "Differential abundance analysis (limma-voom)"
output: html_document
params:
  input: "results/amplicon/merged_bacteria_90%_prevalence.csv"   # output of the filtering document
  metadata: "downstream_input/metadata.csv"    # needs the columns "Sample" and group_column
  group_column: "Origin"                       # metadata column with the groups
  group_a: "Plant"                             # the contrast is group_a - group_b
  group_b: "Soil"
  fdr: 0.05                                    # adjusted p-value cut-off for the table of significant genera
  out_dir: "results/amplicon"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE)
dir.create(params$out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r relative-abundance}
c <- read.csv(params$input, row.names=1, check.names=FALSE)
library(microbiome)
transform <- microbiome::transform
rel <- transform(c, "compositional")
rel_file <- file.path(params$out_dir, paste0("relative_abundance_", basename(params$input)))
write.csv(rel, rel_file)
p <- read.csv(rel_file, row.names=1, check.names=FALSE)
m <- read.csv(params$metadata)
# the samples of the metadata must be in the same order as the columns of the table
stopifnot("sample order of the metadata and of the abundance table differ" = identical(m$Sample, colnames(p)))
m1 <- m
```

```{r voom}
library(limma)
snames <- m1[[params$group_column]]
group <- snames
mm <- model.matrix(~0 + group)
y <- voom(p, mm, plot = T)
head(mm)
```

```{r contrast}
fit <- lmFit(y, mm)
head(coef(fit))
contr <- makeContrasts(contrasts = paste0("group", params$group_a, " - group", params$group_b), levels = colnames(coef(fit)))
tmp <- contrasts.fit(fit, contr)
tmp <- eBayes(tmp)
top.table <- topTable(tmp, sort.by = "P", n = Inf)
head(top.table, 20)
length(which(top.table$adj.P.Val < params$fdr))
newdf <- top.table[top.table$adj.P.Val < params$fdr,]
dim(newdf)
newdf
write.csv(newdf, file.path(params$out_dir, paste0("diff_", tolower(params$group_a), "_", tolower(params$group_b), ".csv")))
```
